summary: The user followed a terminaltools.fun website shared through Discord that purported to provide a tool for adding wallets to a tracking list. After interacting with the site the user reported losing all of their CATE tokens.
user_mistake: trusted a wallet related website shared by contacts in Discord
prevention: Confirm wallet tools through independently verified official sources before connecting or signing / Reject wallet requests from newly created unfamiliar domains
classification_warning: insufficient detail to identify exact compromise mechanism
